facts: 1915 BuildingOrientation has one canonical angle driving forward and inverse helpers. DistantPlacement.occupied_program derives its program from archetype, usage, seed and service_size. TacticalFrom preserves identity, point, elevation and orientation. Prosperity is a separate presentation input.

1915 GeneratedBuilding publicly pairs placement, plan and collision with raw Serde. Normal prepare_buildings takes a recipe by exact program and installs its plan/collision together. A mismatch through arbitrary public construction is not yet a demonstrated successful application path; recipe lookup and actual publication/recipients remain required.

1916 SceneBuildingId is all-u64 physical identity, distinct from opening and geometry source. Placement admission explicitly requires nonzero unique identities; broader identity use is not automatically nonzero. The temporary BTreeSet validates uniqueness.

1917 geometry_datum derives transform from retained collision origin and placement floor each call; GeneratedBuilding does not store a separate world transform. Buried slab bottoms do not select the floor. Original source fixtures were read only.

1918 reservation centre, extents and orientation describe obstacle exclusion including a 5.5-metre apron. They do not choose a terrain floor. Zero extents are expressly permitted, unlike occupied plots.

1919 schema29 and generation73 are distinct protocol facts. Descriptor fixtures require fresh ShopName branding after an operator-name change; validate rejects the stale version. Full validation source remains separately queued.
